test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Sentence of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. They can help you to decide the right products for you.

B. Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest.

C. Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.

D. However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you.
solution:
The correct answer is '**BADC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence B **will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence talking about the advertisements.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because it tells us what advertisements can do.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the next sentence because it further tells us how harmful advertisements can be.
 
• Lastly,** Sentence C **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest.
 
• **A**: They can help you to decide the right products for you.
 
• **D**: However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you.
 
• **C**: Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Passage:__** *Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest. They can help you to decide the right products for you. However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you. Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.*
